entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to make a return. I bought a jersey a little while ago and it's just not right. I'm really disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Sarah Miller. The order number is VF77812. It's the ClubFit Jersey. I saved up for it, and I've been a loyal customer for years... I just feel awful about this.
Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here from about 80 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it's not torn or anything. It's just... I think I got the wrong size. It feels way too tight across the shoulders, and I just can't wear it comfortably.
I understand. Sometimes sizing can be tricky. Since you mentioned it's the wrong size, would you be interested in an exchange for a larger size? We could get that sent out to you.
I don't think so. Honestly, I really needed this money back for some other things right now. I was just hoping I could still return it. Is it too late?

Let me just double-check our policy for you. One moment... Okay, I've confirmed it. Since your purchase was 80 days ago, you are still well within our 90-day return window. So yes, we can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. You have no idea what a help that is.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm happy I could help. I've just initiated the return authorization and sent a pre-paid shipping label to your email on file. Just pack the jersey back in a box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
I will do that this afternoon. Thank you again for being so understanding.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Have a great day.
You too, Sarah. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
